tag: Episode 5 · The Selves on My Side
title: The Selves on My Side

beats.t: The air in the mirror corridor grew heavy. They'd barely dried off after the abyss when the mirror Yeoni raised a hand.
At her gesture, the corridor's largest mirror rose. Inside was a familiar room: rumpled blankets, a charging phone, and the Code Destiny app frozen on its screen.
Human Yeoni sat at the desk. Damp bangs, old hoodie, everything the same except her empty eyes.
That's my room. I still haven't made that bed.
Synchronization. That body is waiting over there, doing nothing.
[ Connecting to reality-return protocol ] [ Candidate: Yeoni / Candidate: Mirror Yeoni ]
[Approve Return] appeared on the phone. Human Yeoni raised her index finger and slid it toward the button. A handspan still remained.
That finger's your clock. Every hesitation brings it a little closer.
Wait. What happens if it presses that?
I go back. I'm the one who enters that body.
Finish before it touches the button. Your hesitation here moves her there.
Small mirror shards rose around the great mirror. An angry Yeoni, a defeated Yeoni, a comparing Yeoni, a smiling-as-if-fine Yeoni filled them.
Wow. More versions of me than I thought. Someone should organize the updates.
[ Distinguish those who wear your face. ] [ Make allies of Peers; cut away Rob Wealth. ]
So they all have my face, but one's on my side and one's a fraud after my place?
Correct. Both wear your face.
Fail to tell them apart, and that finger will only get faster.
The reflected Yeoni snapped their fingers lightly. Click.
Angry Yeoni stepped forward first. Arms folded, she glared and tapped her toe against the floor.
'You always hold it in, then explode too late at the wrong thing.'
Hey. Opening with a brutal truth is cheating.
'You could just say no when you mean no. Instead you act fine, then go home and kick your blanket alone.'
“So you're going to cover it with another joke?” Yeoni shut their mouth. A reply stuck in their throat.
As Yeoni struggled for an answer, black mirror shards grew like thorns at angry Yeoni's feet.
Careful. She's trying to take your share too.
Wasn't that one on my side? Everything it just said was true.
She corners you with true words to take your place. That's Rob Wealth.
Angry Yeoni smiled sharply. 'So I'll speak for you. You can't do it anyway.'
Red glass shot from her fingertips like arrows. Yeongnyangi sprang up to block them. Crash!
Yeoni planted her hooves. Warmth from [乙] rose inside her chest, and green vines sprouted at her feet.
But Angry Yeoni did not stop. “You're always late. Late getting angry, late speaking up, late making every decision.”
She gritted her teeth. It hurt more because it wasn't wrong.
In the great mirror, the human finger advanced one joint. Half a handspan remained.
…Right. I often blow up too late.
But I don't want you exploding for me.
Those wouldn't be my words. A voice coming out with no me behind it.
Being angry isn't bad. But stealing my mouth to shout for me isn't being on my side.
You can be on my side. But not in a way that makes me disappear.
Angry Yeoni stiffened. The black shards at her feet melted away; the red light softened like folding thorns.
“Then... don't just keep holding it in,” Angry Yeoni murmured.
Yeah. Next time I'll say it there and then, instead of kicking my blanket.
Angry Yeoni dissolved into red light. It became a small red mirror shard and settled beside her.
It has turned toward Friend. You have gained an ally.
Oh, did I just catch my first Pokémon? Felt like throwing a Poké Ball.
…Don't think of it that way. They neither run away nor evolve.
In the next shard, defeated Yeoni sat on the floor and barely lifted her head. Her eyes were empty.
“You don't have to try. It's only going to fail again.”
Yeoni's heart sank. Exhausted before even beginning. Nights spent folding her hopes away before they could hurt her.
Gray shards rose around defeated Yeoni. Each showed an application closed before submission, a message written and then erased.
A blue ripple circled beneath the flower on her head: the energy of [亥]. Deep water that could sink but never quite disappear.
But trying and failing hurts for a few days, then ends. Not trying follows me for years. Every time I lie down at night, it comes back.
Defeated Yeoni's voice grew small. '…Then what do I do when it's really too much?'
Then let's rest. Not give up.
Resting and giving up. Let's learn the difference, together.
Defeated Yeoni watched silently for a long time, then nodded. Gray became silver. A small silver shard flew to Yeoni's side.
Your second Friend.
Second one… Is this a loyalty card? Do I get a free gift at ten?
Then the mirror Yeoni clapped. Once. Twice. Three slow claps.
Touching. I nearly cried.
But do you really think they can all be on your side?
Dozens of shards surged forward together: comparing Yeoni, jealous Yeoni, forced-smile Yeoni, self-belittling Yeoni.

“They can do it. Why can't you?” “Pretend you're fine. Don't ruin the mood.” “You've always been unlucky.” “Don't get your hopes up.” “Step forward for nothing and you'll only embarrass yourself more.”
Voices poured from every direction. She wanted to cover her ears, but her blunt hooves let every sound through.
Oh, come on! This is a group chat blowing up at three in the morning!
The voices swelled. “Compare yourself.” “Hide it.” “Give up.” “Just laugh it off.” “There was never a place for you to begin with.”
The finger slid again in the great mirror. Only one finger-joint remained before the button.
The flower on Yeoni's head shook precariously. The green light of [乙] dimmed. Even the ripples of [亥] roiled black.
Yeongnyangi stepped in front and sliced the fragments away. Clang, clang, clang. But they multiplied faster than he could cut them down.
Don't fight them one by one. You'll be buried!
Then what do I do! They all have my face. I don't know where to start!
Wait. If they all have my face, faces can't be how I choose.
Angry me tried to steal my mouth, but finally told me not to bottle it up. Defeated me told me to rest.
Then there's one test. Is that voice protecting me, or taking me away?
The two phrases she spoke clicked together like a lock in her mind. Yeongnyangi paused mid-parry, ears pricked.
Shards that had looked identical began to look different.
Angry Yeoni was really shouting for her to speak. Defeated Yeoni was whispering that she could rest.
But comparing Yeoni kept cutting her smaller. Forced-smile Yeoni erased her where she stood; self-belittling Yeoni quietly emptied her chair.
Anyone trying to protect me, over here.
Green vines opened a path to Yeoni's right. The red and silver shards settled side by side along it.
And those of you who keep eating away at me—
Stay exactly where you are.
What if you're wrong?
Then I'll learn again. Retaking classes is my specialty.
I'm not perfect at choosing. But I won't mistake every voice for my own anymore.
[乙亥] lit before her. A green shoot rooted over deep water. The water was dark but clear; the shoot small but firm.
Yeoni reached a hoof toward the light.
No!
The reflection swept her hand. Comparing, forced-smile, and self-belittling Yeoni merged into a huge black-glass hand reaching to seize all of [乙亥].
Little Sprout, Hang In There! Just three seconds!
Green vines burst forth and wound around the hand. But it was too large. The vines stretched tight and creaked near breaking.
Aagh, is this strength gap real? Somebody patch the balance!
See? You're weak after all. Always were.
Being weak and losing are completely different things.
The water of [亥] moved. It flowed beneath the vines, bracing their roots. The vines thickened, their green threaded with blue.
乙亥 is connected. Now.
Get out of my place!
The vines constricted the black glass hand. Crack. A hairline split appeared across its back. For the first time, the reflection's face hardened.
Yes, I waver! I admit it!
Crack. Fractures spread like a web.
But me wavering doesn't give you the right to live my life for me!
Crash! The black-glass hand shattered. The mirrors of comparing, forced-smile, and self-belittling Yeoni broke with it, scattering into black dust.
Only a few shards remained. The angry self's red shard. The silver one that said resting was allowed. And a small blue shard, newly born.
…Well done.
I really did well, right? Confirm it for me.
Overcome with delight, Yeoni threw up their hooves. Their short hind legs lost balance, and they toppled sideways. The cool pose had lasted exactly three sentences.
Yeongnyangi silently shook his head. Words appeared again in the corridor.
[ Peer classification complete ] [ Rob Wealth purification in progress ]
Wait. In progress? I just cleared it!
The reflection hadn't vanished. She stood calmly on broken shards, looking down at Yeoni.
The finger hadn't stopped either. Its tip hovered a fingernail's width from [Approve Return].
An offer. Stop here, and that finger stops. You can live comfortably on this island.
And that room? The bed never gets made, and that chair stays empty forever?
No. Even if that finger gets closer, I'll finish this myself.
The instant she answered, the finger came down. Its tip stopped against the button's rim. Just one more push away.
Good. Then there's only one left.
I'm the last Rob Wealth.
A chill ran down Yeoni's spine. Black mirror wings spread behind her reflection, every feather holding a face.
Faces she had envied, people she had secretly compared herself to, selves she had wanted to become. And the versions of her face she hated most.
To defeat me, you don't have to break me.
The reflection pointed to the center of her own chest.
You have to take me back inside yourself.
...What? What does that mean?
I'm the self you threw away. Destroy me, and part of you disappears too.
Yeoni searched for a rebuttal and found none. Beside them, Yeongnyangi's expression had hardened too.
The whole island shook again. Words rose above the corridor.
[ Rob Wealth battle ] [ Recover the self within the mirror. ]

Yeoni looked at the reflection for a long time. The reflection looked back in the same way. One human, one flower pig. Completely different faces, yet their eyes resembled each other a little more than before.
I really do make being me difficult.
...You can say that again.
There was no mockery in the answer. Briefly, her face looked like the same person sharing the same weariness.
Before we fight, one thing. If you're really me, you can answer my questions too, right?
Any of them. I have all your memories.
The reflection descended, black wings spread. In the great mirror, the finger still rested on the button.
Good. Then I'll set the questions.
